description: colgrep-mcp: the same search policy as hooks/hooks.json, for readers of the Agent Plugins v1 schema (VS Code, GitHub Copilot CLI), whose loader reads a v1 plugin's hooks only from com.github.copilot/hooks/hooks.json and interpolates PLUGIN_ROOT rather than CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT (hook_namespace R01 C1-C2). The mirror's hooks block must stay byte-identical to hooks/hooks.json modulo that token swap — test_copilot_mirror_matches_the_portable_file pins it. Not here: WorktreeRemove, a Claude Code-only event whose file lives at hooks/worktree-remove.json and is named from .claude-plugin/plugin.json only, so a parser that knows no WorktreeRemove never sees it.
